notes: Polishes the launchable desktop staff application while preserving existing workflows and actions.

Simplifies the Profile Dashboard daily table around staff-facing identifiers, keeps HMIS ID visible, keeps Profile ID hidden for internal use, and restores all Add/Update/Archive/Clear/Undo/Redo/Chart Notes/Pantry QR/Youth Files/Restore actions.
Makes Intake Dashboard packet actions easier to find by separating create actions from selected-document update, regenerate, open, and refresh actions.
Improves desktop Reports table search coverage so Youth Service Log, Requested vs Received, and Sign-In Intake Timeline participate in global search; Excel export confirms visible-row export counts.
Improves the phone/tablet purpose picker with event-first grouping, Event badges, and purpose search while keeping existing check-in submission behavior.
Keeps the 1.0.129 intake hotfixes and 1.0.127 requested fix set intact.
